entries.text: We now support CloudRobo-WM 1.0, with submitted success rates available on the leaderboard.
We now support WorldVLA, with success rates and rollout videos available on the leaderboard.

We now support 18 models: Lingbot-VA, MolmoAct2, Cosmos Policy, π0.5, xvla, FastWAM, GR00T N1.7, OpenVLA-OFT_m, OpenVLA-OFT, OpenVLA-OFT+, Anchor-Align, OpenVLA-OFT_w, RIPT-VLA, π0, OpenVLA, NORA, UniVLA, and π0-FAST.
